label: Contact Sheet
description: Six posts per page as a visual index. A 200-link Twitter report is 200 pages; this makes a batch reviewable in a few, which is the cheapest way to obey RULEBOOK rule 3 (open it and look). Pads rather than crops: a reply capture is parent+reply, and cropping it to a tile throws the reply away — the presentation-layer version of the bug approved edit 5 fixed.
